dedupe_keys.name: catalogue of 55 80 mev solar proton events solar cycles 23 and 24 soho erne 1996 2016

description: This catalogue lists 176 solar energetic particle events near the Earth from 1996 to 2016, covering solar cycle 23 and most of cycle 24, identified from 55 to 80 MeV proton intensities measured by the SOHO/ERNE instrument. Miikka Paassilta and eleven co-authors compiled it, adding ACE/EPAM and SOHO/EPHIN electron data, SOHO/LASCO coronal mass ejections and GOES soft X-ray flares so that each event's likely solar source is identified. For each event it estimates onset and release times by velocity dispersion analysis and time-shifting analysis for protons and near-relativistic electrons, and the paper adds statistics comparing the two cycles. Coverage is the near-Earth environment at daily to minute timing. Format and access: an accepted manuscript on arXiv (July 2017) with the event list as an appendix in an external PDF. Licence: arXiv distribution licence; free to read. Caveats: velocity dispersion results outside 1 to 3 AU apparent path length are judged unreliable, and the list is a PDF table, not a machine-readable file. It supports hazard exposure studies of radiation storms for satellites, aviation and high-frequency communication. A related catalogue record is the S3EP-AC solar energetic particle all-clear predictor, which such event lists help verify.
